answer: Treat reputation like a terrace: every new identity starts on the bottom step and must post a refundable bond that grows with each other account traced to the same funding source. An attacker spinning up fifty sybils from one island of wallets pays rising bonds fifty times over, while an honest newcomer pays once. If any account in that cluster is caught colluding, the slash ripples across all its bonded siblings, so splitting into more identities raises both cost and risk.
